description: This file appears to be a PHP template used in an admin panel for managing channel stories. It contains HTML mixed with PHP for rendering a dropdown filter, buttons for adding stories, and dynamic data insertion points. It also includes JavaScript functions for UI interactions and AJAX requests related to channel story management.

methods.name: toggle_typeahead
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the typeahead search interface.

methods.name: send_story
methods.description: Sends a new story to the selected channel via AJAX and reloads the page upon success.

methods.name: goChannelStories
methods.description: Navigates to the page for the selected channel's stories based on dropdown selection.
